title: Pan-Seared Sushi with Crispy Onion and Zesty Sauce
description: A French-inspired dish combining the flavors of sushi with crispy onion and a tangy zesty sauce. Perfect as an appetizer or side dish.
instructions: 1. Slice the onion into rings and separate them.
2. Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
3. Add the onion slices and cook until crispy, about 3-4 minutes.
4. Remove the onions from the pan and set aside.
5. Cook the sushi according to package instructions or pan-fry it with a little oil.
6. In a small bowl, mix together the zesty sauce and a pinch of salt.
7. To assemble the dish, place the cooked sushi on a plate, top with crispy onion slices, and drizzle with zesty sauce.
8. Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
